name: The diary: a line about yesterday, once the day is over
case: A day of work: three turns, the tests failing on the way, the last one failed. Once the day is over (by the first pass of the new one, an hourly check-in in the night or the morning's first turn), Boop writes one line in its diary about yesterday: one that fits a day with a failure. It writes once, not again on the next event.
why: DiaryOutput: on the first pass of a new day it asks one question, the pack's diary lines (steering/diary.md) that fit yesterday's counts, filled in; the did's day keeps it to once. The counts come from the raw events
